Name: Seraiah, Son of Asiel
Summary: Son of Asiel and father of Josibiah in Simeon's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:35: Son of Asiel and father of Josibiah in Simeon's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Seraiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
